description: Editable capability registry. Entries describe abstract host ports; only host allowlisted providers can dispatch.

phase-runtime-api.description: Loopback REST interface to the native K'UHUL phase runtime. Start with Micronaut.ps1 StartPhaseRuntimeApi.

validate-xjson-contract.description: Pass the XJSON processor's .kl contract through native phase-runtime structural validation. Validation is not XCFE admission or processor invocation.

xsl-runtime-api.description: Loopback XJSON semantic bindings, XML-node projection, and candidate-only field generation for XSL/UI clients. Does not execute XSL, dispatch Micronauts, or grant XCFE admission.

intent-graph.description: Read-only parsed kgf.intent-graph/1 topology; no dispatch authority.

intent-questions.description: CFPC classifies the submitted prompt, then the intent graph returns field/bigram question candidates; proposal-only, no XCFE admission.

eliza-dispatch.description: ELIZA-1 operator-scoped field generation. operator selects one of 16 operators (CAUSE, CONTRAST, DEPENDENCY, CONSTRAINT, EVIDENCE, SEQUENCE, BOUNDARY, STATE, CONFLICT, ALTERNATIVE, INVARIANT, TEST, RELATION, SUBSTITUTE, VERIFY, DIRECT); query is the user text. Returns kuhul.semantic-field-proposal.v1 with eliza_operator, eliza_family, eliza_phase metadata.

code-micronaut-worker.description: Host-invoked CODEGEN/MCDR JSONL worker. Routes are fixed task identifiers; source is passed as bounded JSON data. Outputs are proposals or analysis and are never executed or written by the worker.

generator.description: Deterministic code skeleton proposal; not model synthesis.

refactorer.description: Request refactoring suggestions; no source writes.

optimizer.description: Request optimization suggestions; no source writes.

parse-ast.description: Parse source text through the registered Tree-sitter WASM runtime; language selects a fixed host-allowlisted grammar module.

todos.description: Extract TODO markers from source text.

test.description: Produce test candidates; does not execute tests.

github-review.description: Format review findings as a GitHub review candidate.

xjson-project.description: Project an XJSON value to XML-style nodes and enumerate static API declarations without invoking them.

validate-contract.description: Submit K'UHUL source (.kl/.kgf/.kbnf) to the phase runtime for contract validation; proposal check only, never executes the program.

graphics-compute.description: OpenCL AdamW optimizer lane. Invoke through NumpyTrain so device state and training lifecycle stay host-managed.

pi-learning-fold.description: Replay JSONL experiences, relate records, apply bounded W-C attention/residual proposals, and reward only host-verified outcomes.

cfpc-classifier.description: CFPC intent recognition, query-pattern gap classification, and candidate-field gap routing; emits candidate-only results.

static-site.description: Loopback-only static file host launched by Micronaut.ps1 StaticHost.
